attributes.action: Introduce fuel duty reduction if petrol/diesel prices become exceptionally high
attributes.additional_details:
Millions rely on their vehicles for work, caring responsibilities and everyday life, while businesses depend on affordable fuel.

We want Government to introduce a mechanism to temporarily reduce fuel duty when average UK petrol or diesel prices exceed a set threshold.

This would provide targeted support during exceptional price rises, with normal fuel duty returning when prices fall.
attributes.background:
Introduce a fuel price trigger that temporarily reduces fuel duty when average UK petrol or diesel prices rise above a set threshold.

This would provide targeted relief to motorists and businesses during periods of exceptionally high fuel prices.
